title: The Jaguar Type 01 market
intro: Jaguar registered 16,617 new cars in the UK in 2024 and 1,725 in 2025, while it sold off old stock. The Type 01 starts at £129,950; orders open in early 2027 and first deliveries are promised for the second half of the year. This market resolves in January 2028 on a public web page, and your team name will appear there: pick one you are happy to see in public.

questions.text: How many new Jaguars (all models) will be registered in the UK in calendar 2027, by SMMT's full-year figures?
